The issue is caused by an `AttributeError` when `pkg_resources` (part of `setuptools`) attempts to load entry points during the `finalize_options` phase of `setuptools.dist.Distribution`. Specifically, `pkg_resources.iter_entry_points` triggers a traversal that eventually calls `load()` on an entry point. If that entry point points to a class or function that expects certain attributes on the `Distribution` object (in this case, `_finalize_2to3_doctests`), the error occurs because the `Distribution` class in `setuptools/dist.py` does not have this attribute.

The traceback shows that `setuptools.dist.Distribution` inherits from `_Distribution`, which is a patched version of `distutils.core.Distribution` obtained via `get_unpatched(distutils.core.Distribution)`. The error `AttributeError: type object 'Distribution' has no attribute '_finalize_2to3_doctests'` suggests that `pkg_resources` is attempting to interact with the `Distribution` class in a way that expects this internal attribute, likely due to how `setuptools` monkey-patches or extends the original `distutils` class.

To fix this, `setuptools/dist.py` needs to ensure that the `Distribution` class (or its base `_Distribution`) provides the attribute `_finalize_2to3_doctests` to satisfy the requirements of the `pkg_resources` loading mechanism used during entry point resolution. 

**Plan:**
1.  Modify `setuptools/dist.py` to add `_finalize_2to3_doctests = False` (or a similar appropriate default) to the `Distribution` class to prevent `pkg_resources` from failing when it inspects the class.
